title: ED Cannot Attach Bona Fide Buyers’ Accounted Plots for Developer’s Fraud: SAFEMA
description: SAFEMA Tribunal held accounted plots of alleged bona fide buyers are not proceeds of crime and disposed of appeals with directions for PMLA Court.The post ED Cannot Attach Bona Fide Buyers’ Accounted Plots for Developer’s Fraud: SAFEMA appeared first on TaxGuru.
